title: Tool saves tokens by creating a knowledge graph for faster Claude #AI #Coding #Productivity
description:
This tool addresses the inefficiency of Claude AI consuming excessive tokens at the start of each session when processing codebases. By installing it as an MCP server within Claude Code, the tool scans the entire codebase once and creates a knowledge graph representing file relationships and dependencies. This allows subsequent sessions to reference the graph rather than reprocessing each file individually, significantly reducing token use. The efficiency gain comes from building and reusing a structured context, which optimizes Claude's token consumption, saving both computational resources and operating costs. The setup is straightforward and quick, enhancing user productivity by minimizing redundant processing. Additionally, the tool is open-source and freely available on GitHub, promoting accessibility and community-driven improvements. #ClaudeAI #CodeOptimization #AItools
